_comment: Slot manifest for helper_tex.txd (directive m0061). Textures in 'textures' are packed when their file exists; 'reserved' slots are declared so --strict can fail until real art lands. Name = texture name inside the TXD = name the shader/C++ lookup will use (max 31 chars [A-Za-z0-9_]). Optional per-slot keys: file (override filename), mips (bool, generate box-filter mip chain), format (rgba8888|l8|a8l8), filter (nearest|linear|linearmip), addressing (wrap|mirror|clamp|border), tbd (bool, art is placeholder), note (free text).

cloud_layer0.note: stacked cloud solution - layer card 0 (bottom). TBD art.

cloud_layer1.note: stacked cloud solution - layer card 1 (mid). TBD art.

cloud_layer2.note: stacked cloud solution - layer card 2 (top). TBD art.

cloud_noise.note: R=density G=thickness B=edge A=dither (effects-menu-overhaul.md sec 4). TBD art.

utility_noise.note: R=tileable Perlin G=Worley F1 B=white A=Bayer dither. Functional placeholder.

blue_noise_64.note: 64x64 L8 blue-noise slice (FusionFix bluenoisevolumeL8.dds slice 0). Dither/TAA.

ssr_brdf_lut.note: reserved: split-sum GGX BRDF LUT for IBL/SSR (future lane)

smaa_area_tex.note: reserved: only if runtime SMAA lookup textures are ever externalised (currently embedded CSO/area)
